# nature::dimension

<!-- Generated by scripts/check_spec.py from docs/spec/nature-dimension.toml. Edit that file and run `python3 scripts/check_spec.py --write`. -->

The properties of the physical interpretation of a std metric, from ADR 0002 §3. A reading of a smooth affine object assigns a quantity kind, with a dimension, to each coordinate. A physical interpretation of a metric g under a reading writes each entry g_ij as a rational times a product of scales with integer exponents. The term g_ij dxⁱ dxʲ has the dimension of g_ij plus the dimensions of xⁱ and xʲ. The kernel checks an interpretation; the check is a syntactic dimension check and establishes no physical law.

[Specifications](../specifications.md) defines the [claim statuses](../specifications.md#claim-statuses) and the checks. This chapter is generated from [`docs/spec/nature-dimension.toml`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/docs/spec/nature-dimension.toml).

| Property | Claims |
| --- | --- |
| [An accepted interpretation is consistent](#dimension.consistent) | Proved (oracle), Tested |
| [The Euclidean metric of a length and a time](#dimension.euclid-rejected) | Proved (oracle), Tested |

<a id="dimension.consistent"></a>

## An accepted interpretation is consistent

- Property: `dimension.consistent`
- Subject: `nature::dimension::PhysicalMetric`
- Rule: [ADR 0002 §3, Contract and jurisdiction](../adr/0002-nature-dimension.md#contract-and-jurisdiction)

An accepted physical interpretation of a metric g of an object X under a reading of X evaluates, with the magnitudes of its scales, to the Gram matrix of g. Every term with a nonzero entry has one dimension, and a declared value is that dimension.

- Example: On the chart C = Affine(2)[x, t] read as (x: Length, t: Time), the scales l0 = 3 of Length and t0 = 2 of Time interpret G = diag(1/9, 1/4) as gram((l0^-2, 0), (0, t0^-2)), which is dimensionless. Its gradient of x + t at (1, 2) is (9, 4).
- Run by: `the_scaled_metric_is_accepted_and_its_gradient_is_nine_four` in [`tests/nature_dimension.rs`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/tests/nature_dimension.rs)

Claims:

- `oracle`: [Proved (oracle)](../specifications.md#proved-oracle)
  - Evidence:
    - [`VastitasOracle.NatureDimension`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/lean/VastitasOracle/NatureDimension.lean): `VastitasOracle.NatureDimension.physicalMetric_sound`, `VastitasOracle.NatureDimension.valid_physicalMetric`
  - Premises:
    - for `valid_physicalMetric`: the checked declaration environment is valid and declares the physical metric
  - Assumes: [Rust frontend parsing](assumptions.md#assumption.rust-frontend)
  - Note: `physicalMetric_sound` reads the kernel's check `checkPhysicalMetric`: an accepted interpretation `Interprets` its metric, which states the evaluation to the Gram matrix and the one dimension of the nonzero terms.
- `test`: [Tested](../specifications.md#tested)
  - Evidence:
    - `the_scaled_metric_is_accepted_and_its_gradient_is_nine_four` in [`tests/nature_dimension.rs`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/tests/nature_dimension.rs)
    - `scaled_interpretations_must_match_the_metric_and_its_dimensions` in [`tests/nature_dimension.rs`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/tests/nature_dimension.rs)
    - [`VastitasKernel.NatureRegression`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/lean-kernel/VastitasKernel/NatureRegression.lean), built by [`scripts/check_kernel_regressions.sh`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/scripts/check_kernel_regressions.sh)

<a id="dimension.euclid-rejected"></a>

## The Euclidean metric of a length and a time

- Property: `dimension.euclid-rejected`
- Subject: `nature::dimension::PhysicalMetric`
- Rule: [ADR 0002 §3, Contract and jurisdiction](../adr/0002-nature-dimension.md#contract-and-jurisdiction)

Under a reading of a coordinate of dimension L and a coordinate of dimension T, two distinct base dimensions, the Euclidean metric has no physical interpretation: dx² has dimension L² and dt² has dimension T². The interpretation is an error (`E_DIMENSION`).

- Example: `interpret(E, reading = phys, euclidean)` for the Euclidean metric E of the chart C read as (x: Length, t: Time) is an error (`E_DIMENSION`) that names L^2 and T^2.
- Run by: `euclid_under_length_and_time_is_rejected_naming_l2_and_t2` in [`tests/nature_dimension.rs`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/tests/nature_dimension.rs)

Claims:

- `oracle`: [Proved (oracle)](../specifications.md#proved-oracle)
  - Evidence:
    - [`VastitasOracle.NatureDimension`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/lean/VastitasOracle/NatureDimension.lean): `VastitasOracle.NatureDimension.euclidean_sound`, `VastitasOracle.NatureDimension.euclidean_rejected`
  - Premises:
    - for `euclidean_rejected`: the reading reads the two coordinates as quantities of the dimensions L and T, and L ≠ T
  - Assumes: [Rust frontend parsing](assumptions.md#assumption.rust-frontend)
- `test`: [Tested](../specifications.md#tested)
  - Evidence:
    - `euclid_under_length_and_time_is_rejected_naming_l2_and_t2` in [`tests/nature_dimension.rs`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/tests/nature_dimension.rs)
    - [`VastitasKernel.NatureRegression`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/lean-kernel/VastitasKernel/NatureRegression.lean), built by [`scripts/check_kernel_regressions.sh`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/scripts/check_kernel_regressions.sh)

<a id="dimension.kinds"></a>

## Kinds are not dimensions

- Property: `dimension.kinds`
- Subject: `nature::dimension::Wavelength`
- Rule: [ADR 0002 §3, Contract and jurisdiction](../adr/0002-nature-dimension.md#contract-and-jurisdiction)

`normalized(x₁: s₁, …)` needs each scale sᵢ to be of the quantity kind of its coordinate xᵢ. A scale of another kind is an error (`E_DIMENSION`), even when the dimensions agree.

- Example: `normalized(x: w0, t: t0)` with the scale w0 = 3 of Wavelength on the Length coordinate x is an error (`E_DIMENSION`), and so is `normalized(e: tau)` with a Torque scale on an Energy coordinate. `normalized(x: l0, t: t0)` is accepted.
- Run by: `normalized_needs_the_kind_of_each_coordinate` in [`tests/nature_dimension.rs`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/tests/nature_dimension.rs)

Claims:

- `oracle`: [Proved (oracle)](../specifications.md#proved-oracle)
  - Evidence:
    - [`VastitasOracle.NatureDimension`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/lean/VastitasOracle/NatureDimension.lean): `VastitasOracle.NatureDimension.normalized_rejected_of_kind`
  - Premises:
    - the scale named for coordinate i is of a quantity kind other than the kind that the reading gives coordinate i
  - Assumes: [Rust frontend parsing](assumptions.md#assumption.rust-frontend)
- `test`: [Tested](../specifications.md#tested)
  - Evidence:
    - `normalized_needs_the_kind_of_each_coordinate` in [`tests/nature_dimension.rs`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/tests/nature_dimension.rs)
    - [`VastitasKernel.NatureRegression`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/lean-kernel/VastitasKernel/NatureRegression.lean), built by [`scripts/check_kernel_regressions.sh`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/scripts/check_kernel_regressions.sh)

<a id="dimension.std-independent"></a>

## std does not depend on nature

- Property: `dimension.std-independent`
- Subject: `nature::dimension`
- Rule: [ADR 0002 §3, Contract and jurisdiction](../adr/0002-nature-dimension.md#contract-and-jurisdiction)

Nature declarations change neither the validity of a std metric and its evidence nor the validity and the values of `flat` and `sharp`. The generated code of a program is the same with and without its nature declarations.

- Example: The program that computes the gradient (9, 4) under G generates the same Lean source with its reading, scales and interpretation, without them, and without the nature package.
- Run by: `generated_code_is_byte_identical_without_the_nature_declarations` in [`tests/nature_dimension.rs`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/tests/nature_dimension.rs)

Claims:

- `oracle`: [Proved (oracle)](../specifications.md#proved-oracle)
  - Evidence:
    - [`VastitasOracle.NatureWeakening`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/lean/VastitasOracle/NatureWeakening.lean): `VastitasOracle.NatureWeakening.metric_nature_free`, `VastitasOracle.NatureWeakening.flat_sharp_nature_free`
  - Premises:
    - the declaration ids of the environment with the nature declarations are unique, as in every valid environment
  - Assumes: [Rust frontend parsing](assumptions.md#assumption.rust-frontend)
  - Note: The theorems state validity and evaluation. That the generated code is byte identical is tested, not proved.
- `test`: [Tested](../specifications.md#tested)
  - Evidence:
    - `generated_code_is_byte_identical_without_the_nature_declarations` in [`tests/nature_dimension.rs`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/tests/nature_dimension.rs)
    - `euclid_under_length_and_time_is_rejected_naming_l2_and_t2` in [`tests/nature_dimension.rs`](https://github.com/MGYamada/Vastitas/blob/main/tests/nature_dimension.rs)
